title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Strawberry Watermelon Ice Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Strawberry Watermelon Ice Nic Salt offers a fruity vape with a refreshing twist. The blend of sweet Strawberry and fresh Watermelon is lifted by a crisp Ice finish, adding brightness to the juicy fruit base. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with refillable pod kits. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for smooth throat hit and fast nicotine absorption. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
